jobs.title: Revenue Strategy & Operations Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Serval http://serval.com is an AI-native automation platform transforming how enterprises operate. We build intelligent agents that understand real-world workflows and execute them end-to-end — replacing manual processes and rigid legacy systems with adaptive, learning software. Founded in early 2024, Serval is already trusted by companies like Fox, Notion, Perplexity, Vercel, and Brex to automate high-volume, high-friction operational work across their organizations.

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is the first dedicated Revenue Strategy & Operations hire at Serval and a critical priority for the go-to-market team.

You will lead strategy and operations for Sales leadership: the person who helps run the business day to day and makes the sales team measurably more productive. You will identify the strategic levers needed to accelerate growth, drive the execution to get there, and spot and address the gaps months before they materialize.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Set strategic direction and drive execution

 - Partner with Sales leadership to identify the highest-leverage growth levers (segment focus, coverage model, new motions) and build the case for each

 - Drive forecasting excellence: accurate, defensible, and called early, at the rep, segment, and company level

 - Implement a scalable operating cadence (pipeline generation, pipeline reviews, sales methodology adoption, forecasting, business reviews, etc.) and drive the follow-through

 - Scope and lead strategic initiatives end to end, from thesis through rollout to measured result

Improve workflows and process

 - Find friction in the selling motion and remove it: process, tooling, handoffs, approvals, anything costing reps time they should spend with customers

 - Codify sales methodology, qualification standards, and stage definitions so the motion is repeatable as we hire

 - Improve our GTM systems and data architecture (Salesforce and the surrounding stack) so reporting is trustworthy and process is enforced where it matters

 - Drive adoption of AI wherever possible

 - Look for places Serval itself should be doing this work. We automate other companies' operational drag, and we should be our own best customer

Foster data-driven decision-making

 - Build the analytics that explain performance: funnel conversion, velocity, win/loss, ramp, capacity, segment productivity, and the leading indicators behind them

 - Diagnose current and future gaps, then design and drive fixes. This role is measured on outcomes changed, not dashboards shipped

 - Partner with Finance and Central RevOps on capacity planning, quota and territory design, and headcount modeling

 - Build the tools that help reps understand and run their own business





WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 6-8+ years of experience, with a strong background in Sales Strategy & Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations at a high-growth B2B software company. Consulting, banking, PE, or corporate strategy backgrounds desired

 - Demonstrated experience driving open-ended initiatives from strategy through execution.

 - Strong analytical horsepower: you can structure an ambiguous question, pull the data yourself, spot the insights, and land on a recommendation. Excel or Sheets mastery required, SQL and BI tooling preferred

 - Comfort and credibility working with senior sales leadership through reps, as well as a variety of cross-functional stakeholders

 - Knowledge of Salesforce and the GTM tech stack (Gong, Outreach or Amplemarket, Clay, etc.) a plus

 - Judgment about what matters. The hardest skill here is knowing which competing initiatives actually move the business forward

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias to build. There is no playbook yet. You are writing it

 - Bonus points: experience scaling a company from single-digit to nine-figure ARR, enterprise displacement sales motions, innovation with AI to drive productivity

 - Must be willing and able to work onsite five days per week in San Francisco, CA




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead

At the core of Serval is an agentic AI platform that turns natural language into production-grade workflows. Our agents don’t just respond to requests — they reason, take action across systems, and continuously improve with usage. What began with operational use cases has quickly evolved into a horizontal AI automation layer used across IT, HR, Finance, Security, Legal, and Engineering.

Our mission is to eliminate repetitive, manual work across the enterprise and give teams leverage through intelligent automation. Long term, we’re building the universal AI operations layer — a system of agents that sits across business functions and runs the workflows that keep modern companies moving.

We’re backed by leading investors including Sequoia Capital, Redpoint Ventures, Meritech, First Round, General Catalyst, Elad Gil, and others. 




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re launching a new business line in response to exceptional market demand. As our Business Operations Lead, you’ll act like a GM and own the strategy, operations, reporting, and ultimately the P&L for this function. You’ll partner with the Exec Team, Sales, Deployment, Engineering and Operations to establish our playbooks and then rapidly execute on them to turn this into a strong 8-figure business in the first year.

 - An owner, not (just) an analyst. You establish the plan, work the plan, and live with the result. You’d rather be accountable for a number than merely right about one.

 - Allergic to dashboards nobody acts on. Any report that doesn’t change a decision is a distraction. You ruthlessly prioritize to ensure everyone is focused on the few metrics that matter.

 - A doer, not a delegator. Equally comfortable writing the SQL, restructuring a deal on a Friday night, or sitting down with the deployment teams to figure out how we can expedite time-to-value.

 - Commercially sharp. You think in terms of customer satisfaction, margin, utilization, and attach rate, and know how to build a strategy around it.

 - Relationship-oriented. You know your effectiveness depends on your ability to influence Sales, technical teams, and leadership.

 - High ownership, high slope. You see the gap, you propose the solution, you execute.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own the P&L for your line: you build the operating plan and ultimately own the results, including revenue, margin, and profitability

 - Set and defend pricing and packaging. Build the model, pressure-test it in live deals, and change it the moment the market tells you it’s wrong.

 - Partner with Deployment on unit economics: how do we ensure this business is built to scale while delivering best-in-class customer experience?

 - Partner with Sales on deal strategy. Sit in on the calls, structure the contracts, and figure out how to win the business.

 - Build the forecast and the operating cadence (weekly pipeline, monthly business review, quarterly plan)

 - Scale from the 10k foot view down to the minutiae: where should we open an office? How will we recruit and maintain talent? What do we look for in a candidate?



WHAT YOU’LL NEED

 - 5-8+ years across business operations, strategic finance, corporate strategy, consulting, or an operating role at a high-growth software company.

 - Direct experience owning or materially shaping a P&L, a gross margin line, or a pricing model.

 - Strong quantitative and modeling skills.

 - Working fluency with the systems that run a GTM org: Salesforce, a BI tool, and billing or usage data you can reconcile without help.

 - Real command of software and AI unit economics: COGS, gross margin, payback, net revenue retention, and what changes each one.

 - A track-record of partnering closely with functional leaders to drive execution

 - Comfortable moving fast, being wrong in public, and correcting quickly.



NICE TO HAVE

 - Investment banking, management consulting, or private equity / vc experience

 - Early-stage experience where you built the reporting and forecasting stack rather than inheriting one.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

 - Implement sales process rigor: pipeline hygiene, CRM discipline, accurate forecasting, and deal inspection cadences.

 - Represent Serval at industry events and strategic customer meetings (travel ≈ 25%)

 - 5–8 years of B2B SaaS sales experience with at least 2 years managing and developing high-performing AE teams.

 - Proven track record of building and scaling sales teams at early-stage companies (Seed → Series B).

 - Consistent overachievement as both an individual contributor and a people manager — President's Club, top performer recognition, or rapid career progression.

 - Deep understanding of full-cycle sales in technical or workflow automation solutions, selling to IT, Security, or Engineering buyers.

 - Skilled at coaching complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles (1–4 months) with VP/C-suite decision-makers.

 - Strong player-coach mentality — willing to carry a book of business while building the team and process.

 - Exceptional leadership, communication, and executive presence with the ability to inspire and hold teams accountable.

 - Based in or willing to work from our San Francisco HQ five days a week, with regular travel to support team and customers.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE

 - Management experience at high-velocity SaaS companies such as Verkada, Rippling, Gong, Outreach, Samsara, PagerDuty, Okta, or ServiceNow.

 - Experience hiring, ramping, and scaling AE teams from 0 → 5+ reps in the mid-market segment.

 - Track record of promoting team members and building career paths within your org.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

ROLE OVERVIEW

The opportunities that matter most are often the hardest to get in front of. As our Field Marketing Manager, you'll work side by side with Sales to bring field programs to life across segments and help execute account-based marketing (ABM) plays for our most important accounts. This is a hands-on role for someone early in their career who's eager to learn fast, get creative, and see their work directly open doors and move deals forward.

You'll get real ownership from day one, plus coaching and room to grow. As our West Coast presence expands, so will your scope, budget, and responsibility.




WHO YOU ARE

 - Creative and curious. You see an opening where others see a closed door, and you're always looking for a fresh angle to reach the accounts that matter.

 - Not afraid to try new things. You'd rather test something bold than default to "the way it's always been done" - and you learn quickly from what works and what doesn't.

 - A doer. You're happy to roll up your sleeves: pulling a report, coordinating with a venue, prepping event logistics, or dreaming up an eye-catching way to grab a prospect's attention.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help plan and run field marketing experiences - regional dinners, happy hours, hackathons, and other creative moments - that connect to active opportunities and target accounts.

 - Support ABM programs for key accounts across channels: direct mail, events, digital, gifting, and content.

 - Own the logistics and execution of field events end to end: venues, vendors, invites, registration, on-site coordination, and follow-up.

 - Partner with Sales to understand territory priorities and account dynamics, and make sure every program ties back to pipeline.

 - Track program impact - account engagement, attendance, pilots started, and pipeline influenced - and share what you're learning.

 - Bring ideas to the table. Test new tactics, push boundaries, and help us stand out.




WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - 1-2 years of experience in field, event, growth, or ABM marketing (internships and adjacent roles count).

 - Familiarity with, or eagerness to quickly learn, tools like Salesforce, HubSpot (or similar), and intent platforms (6sense, Demandbase, or similar).

 - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail - you can juggle multiple events and deadlines without dropping the ball.

 - Comfort with data: you can pull basic reports, read metrics, and use them to make decisions.

 - A collaborative style that earns trust with Sales and marketing teammates quickly.

 - Comfortable moving fast, experimenting, and adjusting in real time.

 - A creative thinker who can turn a rough goal into a concrete plan and follow through on execution.

 - Comfortable with roughly 25% travel, up to 50% seasonally.




NICE TO HAVE

 - Exposure to marketing toward IT, Engineering, or Security audiences.

 - Experience supporting events or campaigns in a B2B or startup environment.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Impact: Be a key player in shaping the success of our product and company.

 - Growth: Build a fundamentally new AI product offering with the support of our experienced team and investors. Grow rapidly with the company.

 - Culture: Join a culture that values innovation, ownership, accountability, and fun.

This is a foundational role, and the right person will leave their fingerprints on how Serval operates for years to come.



What You'll Do:

Talent Operations

 - Own Ashby end to end: job and interview plans, scorecards, stages, permissions, integrations, and the data hygiene that keeps our hiring reports trustworthy

 - Build automations and AI agents across sourcing, the ATS, and offers and approvals, so recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators spend their time with candidates and hiring managers instead of on admin

 - Own the offer process end to end, from comp approvals and offer letters to the handoff into onboarding

 - Administer the rest of our recruiting stack, including Wrangle and Juicebox, and own how it connects to our HRIS, Slack, and Serval

 - Manage recruiting vendor and agency relationships, including contracts and spend

Recruiting Enablement

 - Build the training, playbooks, and templates that make great recruiting repeatable, from screening call training for recruiters to interviewer training and reference check guides for hiring managers

 - Onboard new recruiters, sourcers, and coordinators onto our tools and processes so they're productive within their first few weeks

 - Find the bottlenecks in our hiring process (slow stages, late feedback, dropped handoffs) and fix them with better process, tooling, or automation

People Operations

 - Own new hire onboarding from signed offer through the first 90 days (paperwork, I-9/E-Verify, benefits enrollment, and day-one readiness), partnering with Recruiting, IT, and Finance

 - Run offboarding with the same care, coordinating access removal, final pay, benefits continuation, and exit interviews

 - Run our performance review cycles and compensation changes (promotions, merit increases, and adjustments), from timelines and tooling to approvals, letters, and HRIS updates

 - Automate onboarding, offboarding, comp changes, and recurring People requests with Serval agents and workflows

 - Own our HRIS and employee records, keeping data accurate, secure, and audit-ready

Benefits

 - Partner with our broker to select, benchmark, and renew our benefits, including health, dental, vision, life, disability, 401(k), and commuter

 - Lead open enrollment and qualifying life events, and serve as the primary point of contact for employee benefits questions and escalations

Compliance

 - Keep us compliant with US employment and benefits requirements, including COBRA, ACA, ERISA, EEO reporting, and California and multi-state wage-and-hour rules, partnering with outside experts as needed

 - Hands-on experience running core People programs, such as benefits, onboarding and offboarding, and performance or compensation cycles

 - Working knowledge of HRIS platforms such as Rippling, Gusto, Workday, or similar
